kez_switch_weapons.name: Switch Discipline
kez_switch_weapons.lore: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
kez_switch_weapons.description:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
kez_switch_weapons.scepter_description:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

kez_echo_slash.name: Echo Slash
kez_echo_slash.description: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
kez_echo_slash.lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.

kez_grappling_claw.name: Grappling Claw
kez_grappling_claw.description: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
kez_grappling_claw.lore: The speed and agility of the Kazurai allows them to bring down even the highest-flying birds from the sky.

kez_kazurai_katana.name: Kazurai Katana
kez_kazurai_katana.lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
kez_kazurai_katana.description:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. 

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
kez_kazurai_katana.shard_description: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

kez_raptor_dance.name: Raptor Dance
kez_raptor_dance.lore: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
kez_raptor_dance.description:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
kez_raptor_dance.note0: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

kez_falcon_rush.name: Falcon Rush
kez_falcon_rush.lore: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
kez_falcon_rush.description: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.

kez_talon_toss.name: Talon Toss
kez_talon_toss.lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
kez_talon_toss.description: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
kez_talon_toss.note0: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

kez_shodo_sai.name: Shodo Sai
kez_shodo_sai.lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
kez_shodo_sai.description:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
kez_shodo_sai.shard_description: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

kez_ravens_veil.name: Raven's Veil
kez_ravens_veil.lore: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
kez_ravens_veil.description: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark with Parry bonus to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
